payload.title: File:Inabtanin Skeletal.svg
payload.description_html:
Skeletal diagram of Inabtanin alarabia showing known fossil material of the holotype specimen (YUPC-INAB-6-001–010). Elements of the right wing are mirrored for the left side of the body. Scale bar=50 cm.

Key

 =Holotype (YUPC-INAB-6-001–010)
 =Unknown

  • "Morphology and taxonomy of Quetzalcoatlus Lawson 1975 (Pterodactyloidea: Azhdarchoidea)"
